m4ycon:

Extra: P2A had a great increase in “Input Types by Count” since 2026-07-01 until 2026-10-18, which fits our observations. See Input Types by Count, in 1d moving average you can see the start and end of it.

benunskilled:

Follow-up: I checked every block from Oct 7 to Oct 22 for fleet txs. Blocks without any sped up just the same. SecPool and Luxor never included a fleet tx or a sweep, yet on my node:

SecPool: 356 → 114 ms

Luxor: 330 → 98 ms

So here it doesn’t look like the chain txs inside the block were the main cause. Something else in the mempool, maybe? Small samples after Oct 18, and no cmpctblock logs, so I can’t say more. Sorry for the hasty guess earlier.

Oh nice spot. I think SecPool, Luxor, along with Poolin, Binance Pool, BTC.com, … don’t create a template with a Bitcoin Core v28.0 yet. They might still be relying on v27.x or older. See also Bitcoin Core versions run by mining pools and First P2A by Pool.
